requirements.originalBreakdownItem: Add or verify separately adjustable volume controls for music, rain, sound effects, and typing.
requirements.changes: Preserved four independent channels, finite persisted volumes and master/category mute. Interruption restart now requires OS resume permission or explicit category play/enable intent; foreground and volume changes cannot bypass a held channel. Media service reset recreates eligible loops only. Repeated UI cues reuse one player while game collision cues remain independent. Nonfinite fade-in duration becomes immediate finite-volume playback. Loop identity now tracks the requested resource and bundle, replacing a stale channel player when a different loop is requested.
requirements.verification: Five new AVAudioPlayer XCTest cases added; not executed in this environment. Earlier source118 tests remain historical evidence only. git diff --check passed for the two changed Swift files.
requirements.remainingIssues: Founder Mac execution, real interruptions and audible output/quality still require verification; these source changes do not constitute complete requirement acceptance.
